sheets.problem.keyframeOrder: Keyframe times must be strictly increasing.
sheets.problem.keyframeEnd: The last keyframe goes past the duration.
sheets.problem.keyframePose: A keyframe uses a pose that does not exist.
sheets.problem.instructionText: Every instruction needs a text (at least one instruction).
sheets.problem.instructionOrder: Instruction times must be strictly increasing.
sheets.problem.instructionRange: An instruction is outside the duration.
sheets.warn.grouped: {bone} (pose “{pose}”): the skeleton groups fingers and toes into a single bone, so the movement is approximate.

sheets.saveHelp: Every save creates a version without validation: it must be validated again. The previous version and its validation stay in the history.
sheets.saveFailed: The sheet could not be saved.
